mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note_reaction nr INNER JOIN note n ON nr.note_id = n.note_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND nr.attitude = 1

SELECT n.note_id, n.title, n.update_time, n.view_count, n.is_public FROM note_reaction nr JOIN note n ON nr.note_id = n.note_id WHERE nr.user_id = #{userId} AND nr.is_favorite = 1 AND n.del_flag = 0 AND n.status = 1
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND n.category_id IN #{id}
ORDER BY nr.update_time DESC
